test_title: PYST 28: SSC MTS 2024 - Numerical and Mathematical Ability (Held On: 21 Oct, 2024 - Shift 2)
subject: maths
question:
The following table indicates the distances (in km) travelled by 4 vehicles (A, B, C and D) in 2 days and the bar graph indicates the time (in hours) taken by the vehicles to travel the distances, respectively. The x - axis indicates the time (in hours) and the y - axis indicates the vehicles. Study the bar graph carefully and answer the question that follows.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/85742b59e01fe3087a829b834cd96533107dcb2c98ec38f5d978a5225a6fc01d.png] 

Time taken by 4 vehicles to travel the distances.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7cec712ee157e550488283935f65f0c98b9d39c452ff50fcac9a28fbec1cff4c.png] 

Which of the following vehicles travelled at the same speed on both the days?
solution:
**Formula used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

**Calculation:**

Vehicle A: Day 1 = 480 km in 8 hours, Day 2 = 600 km in 10 hours

Vehicle A: Day 1 Speed = 480/8 = 60 km/h, Day 2 Speed = 600/10 = 60 km/h

Vehicle B: Day 1 = 360 km in 5 hours, Day 2 = 420 km in 6 hours

Vehicle B: Day 1 Speed = 360/5 = 72 km/h, Day 2 Speed = 420/6 = 70 km/h

Vehicle C: Day 1 = 720 km in 12 hours, Day 2 = 780 km in 13 hours

Vehicle C: Day 1 Speed = 720/12 = 60 km/h, Day 2 Speed = 780/13 = 60 km/h

Vehicle D: Day 1 = 630 km in 9 hours, Day 2 = 720 km in 12 hours

Vehicle D: Day 1 Speed = 630/9 = 70 km/h, Day 2 Speed = 720/12 = 60 km/h

**∴ Vehicles A and C traveled at the same speed on both days.**
